title.narrative: Local production of a soy-based drink in Nigeria

description.narrative: ACJA Partners/African creameries B.V. was founded in 2021 and is active in the import, export, and wholesale of cream- and coconut-based food products, beverages, and related consumer products. Additionally, the company offers advisory and management services in the field of international trade and the development of agri-food value chains.ACJA Partners is affiliated with Finwerd Flavours & Fragrances (Finwerd B.V., hereinafter Finwerd), a sister company focused on the development and production of emulsions, flavorings, and compounds for the food and beverage industry. The company supports clients with product formulation, process engineering expertise, and quality assurance. Furthermore, Finwerd has operational experience in Nigeria, where it has a local facility that produces flavoring compounds for the food & beverage sector. As a result, Finwerd has a good understanding of local production conditions, quality requirements, and logistics chains.Both companies intend to invest in a production facility for soy beverages in Nigeria. To make this assessment, technical and commercial validation in Nigeria is necessary. A suitable location will also need to be found in Lagos. For this purpose, an investment preparation project is required to develop a business plan.
